title: Oklahoma's Davey O'Brien Award Winners: White Won Twice
question: Which Oklahoma players have won the Davey O'Brien Award?
answer: Billy Sims (1978), Jason White (2003 and 2004), Sam Bradford (2008), Baker Mayfield (2017) and Kyler Murray (2018) have won it. White is the only Sooner to win it twice.
summary: Five Sooners have won the Davey O'Brien Award, six trophies in all, from Billy Sims in 1978 to Jason White's repeat and Kyler Murray in 2018.
body: Oklahoma has a strong claim to quarterback royalty, and the Davey O'Brien Award shows it. The award's own winners list credits the Sooners with six awards won by five different players, spread across four decades from 1978 to 2018.

The honor began in 1977 as the Davey O'Brien Memorial Trophy, given to the top player in the Southwest. In 1981 it became the Davey O'Brien Award for the nation's best quarterback. Oklahoma's first winner came in the Memorial Trophy era: running back Billy Sims, in 1978.

The quarterback era belongs to four Sooners. Jason White won it in 2003 and again in 2004, making him one of only five players to win it twice, along with Ty Detmer, Danny Wuerffel, Deshaun Watson and Mike Singletary. Sam Bradford followed in 2008. Baker Mayfield took it in 2017, and Kyler Murray made it back-to-back Oklahoma winners in 2018.

Count carefully when you trade trivia, because sources differ. Counting only the quarterback-era award, Oklahoma has four players. Including Sims, the school has five winners and six trophies, with White the lone Sooner to win twice.
